title: SWF: CXFormWithAlpha color effects in PlaceObject2
description: Unit tests for color effect encoding in SWF PlaceObject2 tags. Create a SymbolInstance with colorEffect: {type:'tint', tintColor:'#FF0000', tintMultiplier:0.5}, export to SWF, verify PlaceObject2 has HasColorTransform flag and CXFormWithAlpha encodes the correct multiplier/add values. Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/colorxform.test.ts.
